feeding_claim.verbatim: All of our grass-fed beef is grass-finished and tasty.

notes: Verifier: homepage says the farm uses family-run farms for sourcing animals; beef page describes 12 to 16 months at Snug Valley on grass and own hay, so young stock appears bought in and finished here. Year-round farmstand daily 8am to 6pm. Sold at many Vermont stores and restaurants plus Codman Community Farm Store (Lincoln, Mass.) and Archway Farm (Keene, NH). Limited grass-fed lamb about February to April; origin not stated, so not listed.
